decision: rejected JSON as the default result format for program callers

result: markdown stays the default everywhere

result: pending

decision: rejected outputSchema plus structuredContent for program callers (the typed-results one-way door), so the architect arena was not needed

decision: rejected content-type negotiation and _meta-keyed output switching
why: no host sends a format preference; Codex's exec-<uuid> callId is undocumented, and it would only select a representation the prototype showed no gain from

decision: Codex launches drop TRACEDECAY_MCP_REPEAT_READ_POINTERS; the opt-in stays for other single-agent hosts
why: a pointer says the caller already holds the earlier result, which is false for an exec program; pointers also strip structuredContent; they fired in 0 of 160 eval runs, so the saving given up is small
evidence: crates/tracedecay/src/daemon/repeat_reads.rs header; grep tracedecay_repeat_read over all eval rollouts = 0
